kcc_query_text_example: SC marginal horticulture farmer with 1.5 acres borewell-irrigated land in Srinivaspur taluk, Kolar; cultivating hybrid tomatoes and capsicum with drip irrigation; applying for 50% capital subsidy under MIDH for 1,000 sq m naturally ventilated polyhouse structure; need technical specification and subsidy quotation guidelines.

water_and_irrigation.grid_connection_evidence: BESCOM energized agricultural IP set on plot

statutory_flags.tenure_documentation: RTC registered pre-February 2019 in Srinivaspur taluk

attribute_provenance.empirical_baseline: DES Karnataka & Horticulture Dept Kolar: Intensive vegetable and tomato cultivation clusters in Srinivaspur/Kolar taluks, high reliance on borewells and protected cultivation (polyhouses/shade nets) to manage viral epidemics and market fluctuations.
attribute_provenance.farmer_query_inspiration: KCC Karnataka Horticulture query logs: Marginal SC farmers seeking MIDH protected horticulture subsidies for polyhouse construction.
attribute_provenance.statutory_policy_test: Evaluates MIDH Protected Cultivation on marginal SC holding; Tomato recognized under HORTICULTURE_CROPS; land >= 0.25 ac satisfied; mandates existing micro-irrigation asset which is confirmed present; PM-KUSUM Component B disqualified due to existing energized grid IP set; Ganga Kalyana disqualified due to non-dryland status and existing functional borewell; PMFBY crop insurance subject to Rabi 2026-27 Gram Panchayat/Hobli Insurance Unit notification verification.

intended_test_purpose: Validate MIDH polyhouse eligibility with pre-requisite micro-irrigation asset; enforce PM-KUSUM B disqualification on grid-connected borewells; confirm Ganga Kalyana exclusion when functional water asset exists; route PMFBY to Section B pending seasonal IU notification verification.
